notes: Stromkirk Bloodthief. Printed: 'At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target Vampire you control.' The Bloodthief connects for 2 (combat damage is life lost): seat 1 at 18. At the end step the trigger targets the Highborn Vampire (chosen from the legal targets): one counter on it, none on the Bloodthief itself, on the opponent's Highborn Vampire or on the non-Vampire Bear.
